# Version 4.150.0
> **Rendering and filter tools** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 combines Skia m150 with new image-filter tools and faster CPU blurs. Adds paint bounds for quick-reject culling and overdraw visualization. Upgrading also requires replacing remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs; the deprecated notebook integration no longer ships.

## Breaking Changes

- **Replace remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs** — Remaining pre-v4 obsoletes now fail compilation. Use GRBackendRenderTarget constructors without sampleCount, text-run Glyphs/Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions. SKPaintHinting and SKFilterQuality remain in the implementation for ABI compatibility but are absent from the reference assembly. The two SKCanvas.DrawText overloads with SKFont/SKPaint but no explicit SKTextAlign remain warning-only. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **Notebook integration no longer ships** — The SkiaSharp package no longer embeds its deprecated .NET Interactive / Polyglot Notebooks extension. Notebook consumers must replace that integration; this release supplies no replacement notebook extension. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia m150** — Updates the bundled engine from m148 to m150 while preserving Tizen PDF support and the existing Windows runtime floor. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146))
- **HarfBuzz 14.2.1** — Updates bundled text shaping with AAT and Arabic fallback fixes, COLR v1 corrections, and glyph extents that cover the glyph. ([#4167](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4167))

## API Surface

- **Composable filter tools** — SKImageFilter.CreateCrop restricts filter output with a selectable tile mode; CreateEmpty supplies a transparent-black node that discards its input. SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps draw counts to a six-color visualization palette. ([#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228), [#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227))
- **Conservative paint bounds** — SKPaint.GetFastBounds returns bounds including supported effects and stroke inflation for quick-reject culling. A false result means fast bounds are unavailable. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))

## Bug Fixes

- **Faster small-radius CPU blur** — Restores the dedicated raster blur path for small-sigma 8888 images, avoiding the slower shader-based Gaussian path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))
- **Apple typeface stream synchronization** — Fixes a race between opening and reusing a CoreText-backed typeface stream. ([#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower-overhead surface canvas access** — SKSurface.Canvas reuses its managed wrapper instead of repeating native lookups and registration on each access. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

No HarfBuzz binding or shaping changes accompany the test-infrastructure update.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 29, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 added crop, empty, overdraw, and paint-bounds APIs. It also improved CPU blur and canvas access performance and fixed an Apple typeface stream race.
